hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git push'; then SECRETS=$(git diff --cached --diff-filter=ACM -U0 2>/dev/null | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -iE '(api_key|apikey|api_token|secret_key|password|passwd|private_key|auth_key|access_key|GEMINI_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY|GITHUB_TOKEN|JIRA_API_TOKEN)\s*[=:]\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16,}' | head -5); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Potential secrets detected in staged files — push blocked. Remove secrets and use environment variables or .env (gitignored) instead."}'; fi; fi

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '/(perfx|skills)/.*\.py$'; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && RESULT=$(.venv/bin/pytest tests/ --cov=perfx --cov-fail-under=90 -q --override-ini='addopts=' 2>&1 | tail -3); echo "$RESULT" | grep -q 'Required test coverage' && echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  Coverage dropped below 90%! Run: .venv/bin/pytest tests/ --cov=perfx --cov-report=term-missing -q"}' || true; fi
